The site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47. I told Hollis that in a thread on his #central-team message.

On Oct 14 Pree first posted Dock 23 in #central-team, then corrected it to Gate 47 later that day because she'd read the wrong line. Hollis is in that channel, so he can see both messages himself. I found nothing newer that changes it: not in that channel, and not in the knowledge brain.
